Hegemony wire in no man's land is down to 41% after rain, rust and stray bullets. In 29 of 75 sectors there are gaps a man could walk through. Barbed wire is the first line of defense. It slows a raid, holds up a patrol and gives the men behind it cover. A trench with broken wire is a trench with an open door. The front needs hands on the wire tonight. It is slow, quiet, dangerous work, and every yard counts. Comment WIRE under the wiring order on Instagram to join a wiring party.

chronicle.title: A second hospital for each side

blocks.h: A second hospital for each side
blocks.text: Orders came down for both armies: dig a second hospital dugout behind the reserve line. Four more beds on each side, and room for more stretchers. The surgeons will be busy.

The Hegemony killed 100 enemy soldiers first (120 against 100) and took Blackwater Canal. The deadliest rifle belonged to @sugar_cubes745. For 3 days better supplies come up Blackwater Canal to the Hegemony line. The race for Grey Mill begins now: the first side to bring 300 new soldiers takes it.

87 Hegemony raiders went over: 35 Concord dead, 33 wounded in their own trench. 5 raiders did not come back, 21 hurt. Bravest of the night: Bastian Enjoyer (@autism_enjoyer_08), 2 men. 99 Concord raiders went over: 32 Hegemony dead, 49 wounded in their own trench. 12 raiders did not come back, 18 hurt.
